title: intake-orchestrator: sign & index release assets for private installer
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: - Add intake orchestrator job to build, attest, and index private-installer release artifacts. - Ensures signed attestations per-asset and a compact ingestion manifest for air-gapped installs. - Backwards-compatible index format with a migration shim for older installers.
description: Motivation: Private installs need a robust intake pipeline that separates artifact build from signing and indexing so edge air-gapped clusters can pull a compact, verifiable release manifest. Current pipeline bundles all steps which makes offline mirroring brittle and hard to audit. This PR introduces an 'intake-orchestrator' actor that produces per-asset attestations and a sharded compact index consumed by the private-installer. What changed: 1) New CI job ci/pipelines/intake-orchestrator.yaml that orchestrates build->push->attest->index phases. 2) tools/release/attestor: per-asset attestor that uses cosign to produce detached attestations and stores provenance metadata in JSON-LD. 3) tools/release/index-writer: writes a compact release intake manifest with shard metadata, artifact fingerprints, and attestation links. 4) charts/private-installer: adds index-configmap and values toggles to control index version and fallback behavior. 5) terraform module for index hosting and signed index rotation. 6) docs and integration test to validate end-to-end intake to installer flow. Implementation notes: the attestor produces an attestation envelope that includes artifact.mediaType, digest, build_id, builder_id and an incremental raft-like 'artifact_raft_id' used to order shards. Index-writer shards entries by prefix hash to keep shards < 10MB and emits a top-level index.json that references shard manifests. The orchestrator retries transient push/sign failures and exposes per-artifact status to the CI job. Security: signing is performed with cosign using a rotated key per-release. cosign-rotate.sh automates rotation into the release KMS and updates the index metadata to point to the current key id. To avoid exposing private keys in CI logs, signing is executed in an isolated ephemeral runner with KMS-backed key handles; we also added audit log hooks. Backwards compatibility: index-writer emits an index.version field. When the private-installer reads an index with version >1 it uses the new shard fetcher; we added a migration shim in charts that supports older versions by doing a single-file fetch if the installer is on older releases. Tests & CI: added test/integration/intake-end-to-end.test which runs a mini registry, performs a build, pushes artifacts, signs them, writes index shards, and validates the installer's fetch+verify path. CI pipeline includes unit tests for attestor and index-writer and an integration stage that runs on a gated runner. Performance: shard sizing heuristics chosen after benchmarks in benchmark-lab show optimal shard target ~6-8MB for our typical release mix. Observability: index-writer emits Prometheus metrics (index_shards_written, attestation_failures, signing_latency) and traces that are captured by the release pipeline. Rollout plan: feature gated behind values.privateInstaller.indexing.enabled=false by default. Rollout steps: enable in canary release pipelines for next two releases, smoke verify downloads from an air-gapped mirror, then flip default to true. Migration: added migration docs in docs/release/private-intake.md with step-by-step for operators to migrate older installers. Review notes: Marco asked to ensure attestation format is stable and recommended adding a deterministic canonicalization step for the JSON-LD; implemented canonicalizeAttestation() and added tests. Hannah requested stronger CI assertions for key rotation; added an explicit rotation test and a preflight that validates cosign key presence before writing index. Ravi suggested reducing memory footprint of index-writer; refactored streaming encoder to reduce peak memory during large releases. Conversation log highlights: Marco Alvarez (reviewer): "Please ensure attestations are deterministic and signed against a canonicalized payload. Also add a compatibility version in the index." Priya (author): "Added JSON-LD canonicalization and index.version. PTAL." Hannah Cho (reviewer): "CI should fail if cosign key missing or KMS access denied to avoid unsigned indexes being published." Priya: "Added preflight check and unit test, CI now blocks on key presence." Ravi Patel (reviewer): "Index-writer memory was high in my run; consider streaming encoder." Priya: "Refactored to streaming encoder, peak memory dropped from ~180MB to ~28MB in tests." Approvals: Marco approved on 2025-11-17. Hannah approved on 2025-11-18 after CI rerun. Merge: squashed and merged into main on 2025-11-18 via squash merge. CI: all checks passed at merge time. Files changed (high-level): added orchestration pipeline YAML, attestor and index-writer Go packages, chart updates to mount index config, terraform module changes to host index shards behind signed CDN, cosign rotation helper script, integration test and docs. Related work: ties to ENG-4122 (release automation rework) and ENG-4219 (attestation format consolidation). Rollback: index-writer writes a lockfile with the previous index root so consumer can roll back to prior manifest; terraform module includes an invalidate endpoint that can be used to roll forward to last-good index. Notes for on-call: if index ingestion fails in production, disable values.privateInstaller.indexing.enabled in values and re-deploy; the installer will fall back to legacy single-file index retrieval. This PR is intentionally conservative in surface area and gated; further follow-ups will convert other pipelines to use the intake-orchestrator and add more attestation fields for SBOM integration.
